SECRET.

Your Ref: P.47467/1.
Our Ref: PF.66074/F3m.

20th July 1945.

Dear Governor,

I return the letter addressed to OLDAG, which you were kind enough to let me see. As far as we are concerned this can now be given to the prisoner.

Yours sincerely,

G.R. Mitchell.

The Governor,
H.M. Prison,
BRIXTON.
